all_actual_retained_original_extraction_.limits: Exact actual original/extraction/read-record and source-fragment custody. Full publisher originals versus tool captures and historical registrations retain their different statuses. Hash verification does not alone establish applicability or whole-publication visual review; separately recorded bounded manual review applies.

root_bounded_manual_review.scope: Complete sewn polyester plush animal toys, including actual pattern/cut/sew, face attachment, stuffing, closure and whole-toy first release, with original-cohort services separately accounted.
root_bounded_manual_review.bounded_primary_source_review: Root read the actual complete Steiff manufacturing text, Tom product/material/safety/care context and Aurora staged inspections. The general glued cardboard-joint, sewn-eye and wood-wool/mohair routes differ from the genuine polyester plush/PES-fill Tom case; no common SKU/factory, eye polymer, washer or actual factory geography is invented. Manufacturer German legal address does not locate actual production. Tom historical sold-out status is preserved, not asserted current availability; dimensions/recycled share/certification/care limits are not factory defaults. Full actual EPA textile-fabrication selected context/figure and historical reporting limits remain distinct from LCA emissions, controls and zero claims. Upstream real fibre/textile finishing and all actual on-site processes remain complete. Ordinary measured quantities, specific auxiliary identities and actual site QA/provider qualification are unfinished study requirements; no identified intrinsic essential method gap has been waived.
root_bounded_manual_review.whole_native_classification_review: Whole state100 manufactured toy family includes stuffed animal figures; actual complete toy and polyester route fit the broad Product Mass/kg identity without using raw fibre or empty shell as core. Full native regenerated-fibre fabric-versus-staple wording remains a conditional actual supplied-state restriction. Actual official Chinese basenames, every reference/secondary property, kg/MJ/m3 conversions, utility geography, CAS, resource/emission direction and receiver-medium restrictions were independently checked; availability of a Flow does not approve a Process. Narrower38520 association excludes whole dolls and other materials/mechanisms outside this route.
root_bounded_manual_review.manual_bilingual_read_scope: Complete actual EN/ZH critical scope/reference and supported Section5/9 prose; actual independent typed rule/protocol/source/row/context audits separately retained. Does not claim all pages of every referenced publication manually read.
root_bounded_manual_review.accounting: Complete physical stocks and raw transfers, unique original reference event/cohort fates and attributable exchange/service vectors are distinct; whole contaminated Qt, real package/fleet histories, ownWIP once and A/Q0 reviewed.

38520.registration_note: Historical sources with no new common-store registration retain exact original/extraction hashes and prior applicable locators; no invented registration or numeric qualification.

root_bounded_manual_review.scope: Single-charge all-electric closed multi-axis rotational gel/fusion and water-tank cooling of a complete separately supplied unpainted, unrooted hollow PVC human-doll head component through first release.
root_bounded_manual_review.bounded_primary_source_review: Root read actual full Piper rotational/plastisol accounts, Joy separately sold vinyl-head and unpainted/unassembled/no-hair caveats, actual electric/heating alternatives and water-tank machine description, and electroformed mould context. These are a transparent technical synthesis, not one SKU/factory recipe. Equipment voltage/current/power/energy-label defects, generic dipping FAQs and multilayer painted patent alternatives are not adopted as parameters. Separate actual on-site formulation cannot be paper-outsourced; real ingredients, mixing, losses/utilities and complete upstream producer remain once. Complete EPA0010/3542A/8270E programme with incineration/GC-amenable/fraction/recovery limitations is bounded, not demonstrated qualification of a PVC outlet; 3C and Agilent Ar separation have source/matrix and sampling limits. No actual mist, additive, phthalate, HCl or absence is inferred from generic material. Actual unestablished essential method would block the affected concrete study; ordinary QA within established procedures is separately unperformed. No presently identified intrinsic unknown emitted species is asserted to be closed.
root_bounded_manual_review.whole_native_classification_review: Actual full state100 manufactured Parts and accessories of dolls family explicitly includes heads and excludes separate glass eyes; Product Mass/kg is genuine whole supplied component, not resin or whole doll. Narrower38530 head boundary is positively supported by full current UN/Adrie context. Native water secondary Volume0.001m3/kg is preserved as a compatibility restriction, not an independent density measurement or mass-balance filler. Pallet whole-name/wood board-slat route/lumber-mill gate and electrical taxonomy counterevidence are retained: use requires a real complete pallet and real transport/storage/provider bridge, no electricity or raw-board substitution. English fallback plus explicit absence-of-official-Chinese note is disclosure, not an invented native Chinese name.
root_bounded_manual_review.manual_bilingual_read_scope: Complete actual EN/ZH critical scope/reference and supported Section5/9 prose; actual independent typed rule/protocol/source/row/context audits separately retained. Does not claim all pages of every referenced publication manually read.

all_actual_retained_original_extraction_.limits: Exact actual original/extraction/read-record and source-fragment custody. Full publisher originals versus tool captures and historical registrations retain their different statuses. Hash verification does not alone establish applicability or whole-publication visual review; separately recorded bounded manual review applies.

root_bounded_manual_review.scope: Complete printed solid-board flat jigsaw sets, including actual offset printing/finish, paper-to-board mounting, format/steel-rule cutting, complete-piece count, necessary bag/retail packaging and final packline checks before whole-set first acceptance.
root_bounded_manual_review.bounded_primary_source_review: Root read the full actual Ravensburger2025 production article1–23 from retained79267byte publisher HTML, including plates/exposure/rinse, printing/varnish/dry, glue/roller mounting, die manufacture/cutting, immediate heat-sealed bag, cut/count tests, laminated box/closure and final line check before pallet/storage. This is real HTML text, not the old tool-only capture, downloadable PDF or unseen video/images. Root read actual Clementoni complete replacement/count/dimension caveats: nominal1000 may be1008 and a missing-piece service may send a whole puzzle, so no piece/mass/geometry/default equality. Source force/time/throughput/forest/reduction marketing and material supplier geography are not PCR defaults. EPA sheetfed/web/waterless and whole mass-balance conditions are distinct, historical control/reporting data not universal factors. All real prepress/retail packaging manufacturing retain complete owned or compatible upstream producer histories once.
root_bounded_manual_review.whole_native_classification_review: Whole state100 Puzzles/智力玩具 finished Product Mass/kg covers actual complete jigsaw. First release includes real bag/box/line-QC completion where required, while net reference mass excludes removable packaging; later service keeps original cohort and no new Q. Real nine packaging pools have six gross legs, ER inward and EO outward, full wet stocks and actual increments; packaging nested in a filled returned article is reconciled with net content once. Full native paper/PE bags, wooden pallet, source-specific utility and water secondary properties retained; no bulk board, die, loose rejected pieces or incomplete set substituted for the core. Narrower38550, not all puzzles.
